<module id="div_8bit">
	<description>Perform division operation on 8-bit operands.</description>
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
		<input id="rst">Reset signal.</input>
		<input id="sign">1-bit indicating if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
		<input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
		<input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
		<input id="opn_valid">1-bit indicating that a valid operation request is present.</input>
		<input id="res_ready">1-bit indicating that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged.</input>
		<output id="res_valid">1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
		<output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
	endports
	
	<implementation>
		// Register declarations
		reg [7:0] dividend_reg;
		reg [7:0] divisor_reg;
		reg [15:0] SR;
		reg [3:0] cnt;
		reg start_cnt;
		
		wire signed [7:0] dividend_signed;
		wire signed [7:0] divisor_signed;
		wire signed [15:0] dividend_abs;
		wire signed [15:0] divisor_abs;
		wire signed [15:0] remainder;
		wire signed [15:0] quotient;
		
		assign dividend_signed = $signed(dividend);
		assign divisor_signed = $signed(divisor);
		assign dividend_abs = {dividend_signed[7], dividend_signed};
		assign divisor_abs = {divisor_signed[7], divisor_signed};
		
		// Negate the divisor for subtraction
		wire signed [15:0] NEG_DIVISOR;
		assign NEG_DIVISOR = -$signed(divisor_abs);
		
		// Remainder calculation
		assign remainder = SR[15:8];
		assign quotient = SR[7:0];
		
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst) begin
				dividend_reg <= 8'd0;
				divisor_reg <= 8'd0;
			end else if(opn_valid && !res_valid) begin
				dividend_reg <= dividend;
				divisor_reg <= divisor;
			end
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst) begin
				SR <= 16'd0;
			end else if(!start_cnt) begin
				SR <= {{8{dividend_abs[7]}}, dividend_abs} << 1; // Shift left by 1
			end else begin
				SR <= {remainder[14:0], remainder[15]};
			end
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst) begin
				cnt <= 4'd0;
			end else if(start_cnt) begin
				cnt <= cnt + 1;
			end else begin
				cnt <= 4'd0;
			end
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst) begin
				start_cnt <= 1'b0;
			end else if(cnt == 4'd8) begin
				start_cnt <= 1'b0;
			end else if(opn_valid && !res_valid) begin
				start_cnt <= 1'b1;
			end
		end
		
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst) begin
				res_valid <= 1'b0;
			end else if(cnt == 4'd8) begin
				res_valid <= 1'b1;
			end else if(res_valid & res_ready) begin
				res_valid <= 1'b0;
			end else begin
				res_valid</implementation></ports></module>
